---
title: svelte-vanilla
description: Svelte 5 client with native scoped <style> CSS.
---

Branch: `template/svelte-vanilla` — Svelte 5 with native scoped CSS in
`<style>` blocks, no CSS framework.

- Each `.svelte` component has a `<style>` block that the Svelte compiler
  auto-scopes (adds a hash class to elements and selectors).
- Use `:global()` for selectors targeting slotted content from child
  components or ancestor-based selectors like `[data-theme="dark"]`.
- `styles.css` holds only global base: design tokens, reset, and shared UI
  primitives (`.btn`, `.badge`, `.panel`, `.table`, `.avatar`).
- The Svelte plugin (`svelte-plugin.ts`) extracts compiled CSS to temp files
  and Bun.build bundles all `<style>` blocks into one output stylesheet.

```bash
bun create dulak@latest my-app --template svelte-vanilla
```
